168	        keep &= ~np.isin(ses, list(T.block_embargo[b]))
169	    return train_idx[keep]
170	
171	
172	def purged_splits(T):
173	    """12 (train_idx, test_idx) over IS rows: test = one block; train = the other blocks, purged and embargoed."""
174	    is_idx = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
175	    for b in range(N_BLOCKS):
176	        te = is_idx[T.block[is_idx] == b]
177	        tr = _purge(T, is_idx[T.block[is_idx] != b], [b])
178	        yield tr, te
179	
180	
181	def cpcv_splits(T):
182	    """66 (train_idx, test_idx, (a, b)) with two test blocks each (N = 12, k = 2), purged against both and their embargoes."""
183	    is_idx = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
184	    for a, b in itertools.combinations(range(N_BLOCKS), CPCV_K):
185	        te = is_idx[np.isin(T.block[is_idx], [a, b])]
186	        tr = _purge(T, is_idx[~np.isin(T.block[is_idx], [a, b])], [a, b])
187	        yield tr, te, (a, b)
188	
189	
190	def cpcv_paths(T, oof_by_split):
191	    """11 backtest paths from the 66 CPCV splits. oof_by_split: {(a, b): array of decisions / scores for the rows of that
192	    split's test set, in the order cpcv_splits yields them}. Returns a list of 11 arrays over all rows (NaN outside IS): in
193	    path p, block g takes its prediction from the split that pairs g with its p-th other block."""
194	    is_idx = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
195	    paths = [np.full(T.n, np.nan) for _ in range(N_BLOCKS - 1)]
196	    for (a, b), pred in oof_by_split.items():
197	        te = is_idx[np.isin(T.block[is_idx], [a, b])]
198	        pred = np.asarray(pred, dtype=float); assert len(pred) == len(te), "prediction length must match the split's test rows"
199	        for g, other in ((a, b), (b, a)):
200	            p = [x for x in range(N_BLOCKS) if x != g].index(other)
201	            m = T.block[te] == g
202	            paths[p][te[m]] = pred[m]
203	    for p in paths: assert not np.isnan(p[is_idx]).any(), "every IS row must have a prediction in every path"
204	    return paths
205	
206	
207	def check_splits(T):
208	    """Leakage checks of the splitter: no training row's lifetime intersects its test block, no training row sits in the
209	    embargo, every IS row is tested once in the 12-block scheme; returns the counts."""
210	    n_te = np.zeros(T.n, dtype=int); purged = []
211	    for b, (tr, te) in enumerate(purged_splits(T)):
212	        lo, hi = T.block_range[b]
213	        assert not ((T.entry_bar[tr] <= hi) & (T.exit_bar[tr] >= lo)).any()
214	        assert not np.isin(T.session[tr], list(T.block_embargo[b])).any()
215	        assert (T.block[te] == b).all()
216	        n_te[te] += 1; purged.append(int(T.is_mask.sum() - len(te) - len(tr)))
217	    assert (n_te[T.is_mask] == 1).all() and (n_te[T.oos_mask] == 0).all()
218	    return dict(blocks=N_BLOCKS, rows_is=int(T.is_mask.sum()), rows_oos=int(T.oos_mask.sum()), purged_per_block=purged,
219	                block_sessions=[len(bs) for bs in T.block_sessions], block_rows=[int((T.block == b).sum()) for b in range(N_BLOCKS)],
220	                cpcv_splits=sum(1 for _ in cpcv_splits(T)))
221	
222	
223	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scoring (the only way to a number)
224	def _units(T, idx, gate="RAW"):
225	    return [dict(entry=int(T.setup_i[i]), setup=int(T.setup_i[i]), gate=gate, day=str(T.day[i]), exit_day=str(T.day[i]), legs=1,
226	                 net=float(T.net[i]), gross=float(T.net[i]), charges=0.0, slip=0.0, open=False) for i in idx]
227	
228	
229	def _split_rows(T, split):
230	    if split == "IS": return np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
231	    if split == "OOS":
232	        if os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) != "oos_once.py":
233	            raise PermissionError("OOS rows are scored by oos_once.py alone (BRIEF protocol: OOS is opened once)")
234	        return np.flatnonzero(T.oos_mask)
235	    raise ValueError(split)
236	
237	
238	def metrics(T, keep, rows, tag, controls=True, draws=CONTROL_DRAWS):
239	    """Kept-vs-skipped metrics of a boolean keep mask over the rows `rows` of T (a subset of one split)."""
240	    keep = np.asarray(keep, dtype=bool)
241	    k = rows[keep[rows]]; s = rows[~keep[rows]]
242	    net, win = T.net, T.win
243	    nk, ns = len(k), len(s)
244	    m = dict(n=int(len(rows)), kept_n=int(nk), skipped_n=int(ns), kept_share=round(nk / len(rows), 4) if len(rows) else None,
245	             kept_net=round(float(net[k].sum()), 2), skipped_net=round(float(net[s].sum()), 2),
246	             kept_mean=round(float(net[k].mean()), 2) if nk else None, skipped_mean=round(float(net[s].mean()), 2) if ns else None,
247	             all_mean=round(float(net[rows].mean()), 2) if len(rows) else None,
248	             kept_win_rate=round(float(win[k].mean()), 4) if nk else None, skipped_win_rate=round(float(win[s].mean()), 4) if ns else None,
249	             kept_pf=None, kept_t=None, diff=None, diff_top1_removed=None, kept_mean_slip3=None, kept_mean_slip8=None,
250	             loser_recall=None, loser_precision=None, winner_recall=None, winner_recall_weighted=None, top_decile_winners_skipped=None,
251	             kept_sessions=int(len(set(T.session[k].tolist()))), sign_blocks=None, perm_p=None, control_pct=None, control_p_beat=None)
252	    if nk:
253	        w_, l_ = net[k][net[k] > 0], net[k][net[k] <= 0]
254	        m["kept_pf"] = round(float(w_.sum() / -l_.sum()), 3) if len(l_) and l_.sum() else None
255	        m["kept_t"] = round(float(net[k].mean() / (net[k].std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(nk))), 2) if nk > 1 and net[k].std(ddof=1) else None
256	    if nk and ns:
257	        m["diff"] = round(float(net[k].mean() - net[s].mean()), 2)
258	        # slippage moves every trade's net by the same amount, so the kept-vs-skipped difference is invariant; what a marginal
259	        # gate must survive is the kept book's own expectancy at 3 / 8 pts per side
260	        for sl_ in (3.0, 8.0): m[f"kept_mean_slip{int(sl_)}"] = round(float(T.net_slip[sl_][k].mean()), 2)

import os, sys, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
OUT="/home/user/money-maker/research/strategy_lab/fz_v3/out"
sys.path.insert(0, OUT); import harness as H
FE=os.path.join(OUT,"features_ext"); ST=os.path.join(OUT,"studies/ext_features")
fj=json.load(open(os.path.join(ST,"findings.json")))
CUT="trunc_20250630_120000"
for tf in ("minute","5minute"):
    print("="*30, tf)
    X=pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(FE,tf,"ext_features.parquet"))
    XA=pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(FE,tf,"ext_features_all.parquet"))
    XT=pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(FE,tf,CUT,"ext_features_all.parquet"))
    F=pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT,"data",tf,"features.parquet"),columns=["setup_i","split","session_bar","date"])
    B=pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT,"data",tf,"bars.parquet"),columns=["i","datetime","date","split","session_idx"])
    BT=pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT,"data",tf,CUT,"bars.parquet"),columns=["i","datetime"])
    FT=pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT,"data",tf,CUT,"features.parquet"),columns=["setup_i"])
    S=pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT,"data",tf,"sessions.parquet"))
    cols=[c for c in X.columns if c!="setup_i"]
    print("rows",len(X),"cols",len(cols),"| findings rows/cols",fj["timeframes"][tf]["rows"],fj["timeframes"][tf]["columns"])
    print("ext == ext_all identical:", X.equals(XA))
    print("setup_i matches base features:", np.array_equal(np.sort(X.setup_i.to_numpy()), np.sort(F.setup_i.to_numpy())), "| IS setups", int((F.split=="IS").sum()), "OOS", int((F.split=="OOS").sum()))
    T=H.load(tf); print("L1 units H.load(tf).n:",T.n,"| findings",fj["timeframes"][tf]["l1_units"])
    print("bars",len(B),"| findings",fj["timeframes"][tf]["bars"])
    fit=(B.split.astype(str)=="IS")&(B.date.astype(str)>="2021-10-01")&(B.date.astype(str)<="2023-09-30")
    print("fit bars",int(fit.sum()),"fit sessions",B.session_idx[fit].nunique(),"| findings",fj["timeframes"][tf]["fit_bars"],fj["timeframes"][tf]["fit_sessions"])
    is_sess=S[S.split.astype(str)=="IS"]; print("IS sessions total",len(is_sess),"; fit share of IS sessions", round(B.session_idx[fit].nunique()/len(is_sess),3))
    # truncation: trunc bars are a prefix of full bars
    nb=len(BT); print("trunc bars",nb,"| findings",fj["timeframes"][tf]["trunc"]["bars"])
    print("trunc bars prefix of full (datetime equal):", np.array_equal(BT.datetime.to_numpy(), B.datetime.to_numpy()[:nb]), "| last trunc bar:", BT.datetime.iloc[-1])
    pre=X[X.setup_i<nb].reset_index(drop=True); XT=XT.sort_values("setup_i").reset_index(drop=True); pre=pre.sort_values("setup_i").reset_index(drop=True)
    print("setups before cut full/trunc/base-trunc-features:",len(pre),len(XT),len(FT),"| keys equal:",np.array_equal(pre.setup_i.to_numpy(),XT.setup_i.to_numpy()))
    mad=0.0; nd=0; nanmis=0
    for c in cols:
        x=pre[c].to_numpy(float); y=XT[c].to_numpy(float)
        nanmis+=int((np.isnan(x)!=np.isnan(y)).sum()); b=~np.isnan(x)&~np.isnan(y)
        if b.any():
            d=np.abs(x[b]-y[b]); mad=max(mad,float(d.max())); nd+=int((d>1e-9).sum())
    print("INDEPENDENT trunc diff: max|diff|",mad,"rows differing",nd,"nan-pattern mismatches",nanmis)
    # coverage
    cov={c:round(float(X[c].notna().mean()),4) for c in cols}
    print("coverage matches findings.json:", cov==fj["timeframes"][tf]["coverage"], "| min",min(cov.values()),"median",float(np.median(list(cov.values()))))
    print("cols <0.99:",[c for c,v in cov.items() if v<0.99])
    # explain coverage arithmetic
    sb=F.set_index("setup_i").loc[X.setup_i,"session_bar"].to_numpy()
    print("share session_bar>=2 (CSW needs 3 session bars):", round(float((sb>=2).mean()),4), "| csw coverage", cov["csw_max_abs"])
    print("share setup_i>=502 (FFD vol window 503):", round(float((X.setup_i>=502).mean()),4), "| ffd coverage", cov["ffd_vol_dstar"], cov["ffd_close_dstar"])
    # HMM arithmetic from the report
    rep=json.load(open(os.path.join(FE,tf,"ext_fit_report.json")))
    for K in ("K3","K4"):
        h=rep["hmm"][K]; tm=np.array(h["transmat"])
        w,v=np.linalg.eig(tm.T); st=np.real(v[:,np.argmin(np.abs(w-1))]); st=st/st.sum()
        dwell=[round(1/(1-tm[s,s]),1) for s in range(len(tm))]
        print(K,"rows of transmat sum to 1:",np.allclose(tm.sum(1),1,atol=2e-4),"| stationary recomputed",np.round(st,4).tolist(),"report",h["stationary"],"| dwell recomputed",dwell,"report",h["expected_dwell_bars"])
        print("   findings.json state_means == report:", fj["timeframes"][tf]["hmm"][K]["state_means"]==h["state_means"], "| means ordered by range_atr asc:", all(np.diff([m[1] for m in h["state_means"]])>0))
        print("   filter check:",h["filter_validation"], "| tape share", h["state_share_tape"])
    print("jump lambda*:",{K:rep["jump"][K]["lambda_star"] for K in ("K3","K4")},"| findings",fj["timeframes"][tf]["jump_lambda"])
    print("ffd:",{n:(rep["ffd"][n]["d_star_fit"],rep["ffd"][n]["d_star_is"],rep["ffd"][n]["d_star_used"],rep["ffd"][n]["window_used"]) for n in ("close","vol")})
    print("rv mismatch:",rep["rv_check_choch_since_bos_mismatch"], "| fit_last_bar", rep["fit_last_bar"], "< trunc bars", rep["fit_last_bar"]<nb)
    # ffd window arithmetic
    sys.path.insert(0, ST); import ext_lib as L
    print("ffd window len d=0.2:",len(L.ffd_weights(0.2,1e-4)),"d=0.1:",len(L.ffd_weights(0.1,1e-4)))
EOF

issues.what: Every unsupervised fit (RV z-scoring, GMM, HMM, jump centroids + lambda, BOCPD standardisation, FFD d*) is estimated once on the first IS half (489 of 1,026 IS sessions) and then applied to all bars, including the fit window's own bars. The design's binding leakage control for regime-states says parameters and z-scoring statistics are 'estimated on IS training-fold bars only, refit per fold'. For the harness splitter this means blocks 0-4 are 100% inside the fit window and block 5 is 72% inside: the 35 model-derived columns are in-sample there and out-of-sample for blocks 6-11. Label-free, so no outcome can leak, and the study discloses the in-sample effect, but it does not spell out that Judge 2's two-halves stability check (2021-10..2023-09 vs 2023-10..2025-12) for these columns compares an in-sample half with an out-of-sample half, nor that the truncation check is blind to it.
